accounts_password_requires_login.name: accounts_password_requires_login
accounts_password_requires_login.value: "accounts"."password_hash" is null or "accounts"."login_canonical" is not null

lobbies_active_phase_has_race.name: lobbies_active_phase_has_race
lobbies_active_phase_has_race.value: "lobbies"."phase" not in ('countdown', 'racing', 'results') or "lobbies"."current_race_id" is not null

lobby_members_one_subject.name: lobby_members_one_subject
lobby_members_one_subject.value: ("lobby_members"."account_id" is not null) <> ("lobby_members"."guest_session_id" is not null)

race_entrants_identity_kind.name: race_entrants_identity_kind
race_entrants_identity_kind.value: ("race_entrants"."kind" = 'human' and "race_entrants"."account_id" is not null and "race_entrants"."bot_level" is null) or ("race_entrants"."kind" = 'guest' and "race_entrants"."account_id" is null and "race_entrants"."member_id" is null and "race_entrants"."bot_level" is null and "race_entrants"."display_name_snapshot" = '#' || "race_entrants"."ordinal"::text) or ("race_entrants"."kind" = 'bot' and "race_entrants"."account_id" is null and "race_entrants"."member_id" is null and "race_entrants"."bot_level" is not null and "race_entrants"."bot_level" in ('noob', 'beginner', 'intermediate', 'expert', 'impossible'))

races_started_matches_state.name: races_started_matches_state
races_started_matches_state.value: ("races"."state" = 'countdown' and "races"."started_at" is null) or ("races"."state" in ('racing', 'finished') and "races"."started_at" is not null) or "races"."state" = 'interrupted'

profile_photos_webp.name: profile_photos_webp
profile_photos_webp.value: substring("profile_photos"."webp" from 1 for 4) = decode('52494646', 'hex') and substring("profile_photos"."webp" from 9 for 4) = decode('57454250', 'hex')

race_wpm_series_points_bound.name: race_wpm_series_points_bound
race_wpm_series_points_bound.value:
case when jsonb_typeof("race_wpm_series"."series"->'points') = 'array'
    then jsonb_array_length("race_wpm_series"."series"->'points') between 1 and 512 else false end

lobby_invitations_binding_complete.name: lobby_invitations_binding_complete
lobby_invitations_binding_complete.value: ("lobby_invitations"."bound_member_id" is null and "lobby_invitations"."bound_ip_digest" is null and "lobby_invitations"."bound_at" is null) or ("lobby_invitations"."bound_member_id" is not null and "lobby_invitations"."bound_ip_digest" is not null and "lobby_invitations"."bound_at" is not null)

lobby_invitations_times_ordered.name: lobby_invitations_times_ordered
lobby_invitations_times_ordered.value: ("lobby_invitations"."bound_at" is null or "lobby_invitations"."bound_at" >= "lobby_invitations"."created_at") and ("lobby_invitations"."revoked_at" is null or "lobby_invitations"."revoked_at" >= "lobby_invitations"."created_at")
